manifest.help_text: Manifest containing paths to fasta genomic DNA sequence files with header containing at least the columns: `ID,assembly`. (mandatory)

combine_annotations.help_text: Previously generated annotation in GFF3 format are to be combined with the Bakta anotation generated in this pipeline. These annotation files should be provided in the input manifest by adding a column with header `annotations`.

monochrome_logs.help_text: Should logs appear in plain ASCII
